ui_bugs.issue: Missing import for ArrowRightIcon caused entire Report page to crash on render (ReferenceError). Fixed by testing agent — added `ArrowRight as ArrowRightIcon` to lucide-react import. Please verify.

Clicking an adjacent-career-N Link updates the URL (e.g. /career/Software%20Engineer -> /career/DevOps%20Engineer) but the page continues to display the previous career's title, salary, skills etc. No loader shown, no refetch triggered. Verified with 30s wait. Direct URL entry works fine. Suspected cause: `user` object referenced in useEffect deps `[title, lang, user, stream]` — its identity may be stable but interaction with react-router same-route re-render may be swallowing the update. Consider (a) using JSON.stringify(user) or user?.id in deps, (b) adding `key={title}` to <CareerExplorer /> route element in App.js to force remount, or (c) using a `useLocation`/pathname trigger.

rca of the issue: Bug 1 (fixed): Report.jsx referenced <ArrowRightIcon size=14 /> at line 94 but the lucide-react import at line 5 never listed it. This caused ReferenceError during render, blanking the entire /report/:id page and breaking the whole 'Careers that fit you' section — including the newly-added explore-career-N Links. Fix: added `ArrowRight as ArrowRightIcon` to the import. Bug 2 (open): CareerExplorer's useEffect depends on `[title, lang, user, stream]`. When you click an in-page <Link to=/career/OtherName>, react-router matches the SAME route pattern (/career/:title), so React reuses the component instance and only params change. In this scenario useEffect SHOULD fire because `title` changed — but our test observed no loader and no data change over 30s, implying the effect isn't running (or the setData is discarded). Most likely cause: `user` in deps is a fresh object reference each render but its shallow-equal skips detection in some flows; alternatively, react-router's params update is batched with a state that setData reads stale. Recommended fix: add `key={window.location.pathname}` or `<Route ... element={<CareerExplorer key={useParams().title}/>}` to force remount on title change, and/or narrow useEffect deps to `[title, lang, user?.id, user?.grade, user?.education_board]`.
